description:
## What to do

Adapt the upstream extensions doc (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/extensions.md, 2536 lines — the longest doc) for our Elixir system.

## Upstream source

- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/extensions.md
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts (1543 lines)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/runner.ts (1000+ lines)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/loader.ts (606 lines)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/event-bus.ts (34 lines)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/wrapper.ts (31 lines)

## Output

Create docs/extensions.md

## How to adapt

This is the largest doc at 2536 lines. Structure it in major sections:

### 1. Architecture Overview
Document our three-layer architecture:
- **Extension.Behaviour** — the behaviour all extensions must implement
- **OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Loader** — discovery and loading
- **OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Runner** — dispatch and lifecycle
- **OctoPi.Coder.Extension.EventBus** — inter-extension pub/sub

### 2. Extension Definition
Show our Elixir extension macro:
```elixir
defmodule MyExtension do
  use OctoPi.Coder.Extension

  def mount(ctx), do: {:ok, ctx}
  def handle_event(:agent_start, _event, ctx), do: {:ok, ctx}
  def handle_event(event, _event, ctx), do: {:ok, ctx}
  def unmount(ctx), do: ctx
end
```

### 3. Event Types
Convert all TypeScript event type strings to our Elixir event atoms. List all events our system supports:
- `:agent_start`, `:agent_end`
- `:turn_start`, `:turn_end`
- `:message_start`, `:message_update`, `:message_end`
- `:tool_execution_start`, `:tool_execution_update`, `:tool_execution_end`
- `:compaction_start`, `:compaction_end`
- `:queue_update`
- `:auto_retry_start`, `:auto_retry_end`
- `:extension_error`
- `:session_before_compact`
- `:session_before_tree`
- `:session_before_switch`
- `:session_before_fork`
- `:session_start`, `:session_stop`
- `:session_switch`, `:session_new`
- `:tool_call`, `:tool_call_result`
- `:command_call`, `:command_result`
- `:input_event`
- `:extension_ui_request`

### 4. Emission Patterns
Document our six emission patterns (how events reach handlers). This maps to our Registry-based dispatch.

### 5. ExtensionAPI
Document our `OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Context` (the ctx passed to handlers) and `OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Host` (the host interface). List all available methods:
- Session control: `new_session/1`, `switch_session/1`, `fork/2`, `compact/2`
- Model control: `set_model/2`, `cycle_model/1`, `get_available_models/1`
- Thinking: `set_thinking_level/2`, `cycle_thinking_level/1`
- UI: `select/5`, `confirm/4`, `input/4`, `editor/4`, `notify/3`, `set_status/3`, `set_widget/4`, `set_title/1`, `set_editor_text/1`
- Tools: `register_tool/2`, `unregister_tool/1`
- Commands: `register_command/3`

### 6. Loading & Discovery
Document our discovery hierarchy:
- Global: `~/.octo_pi/extensions/`
- Project: `.pi/extensions/`
- Settings: `extensions` array
- CLI: `--extension` flag

### 7. Reference Extensions
Document our built-in reference extensions and their purposes.

### 8. Example Extensions
Document our example extensions (hello, commands, event-bus, session-name, tools, dynamic-tools, permission-gate, protected-paths, trigger-compact, custom-compaction, auto-commit-on-exit, git-checkpoint, message-renderer, custom-header, custom-footer, status-line, provider-payload).

## What to preserve verbatim

- The event type list (adapted to Elixir atoms)
- The extension lifecycle (mount → event handling → unmount)
- The discovery hierarchy
- The ExtensionAPI method signatures (adapted to Elixir)

## Key upstream references to include

- [types.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts)
- [runner.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/runner.ts)
- [loader.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/loader.ts)
- [event-bus.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/event-bus.ts)

## Testing the doc

After writing, verify:
1. All event atoms match our actual `OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Event` types
2. All Context/Host methods match our actual API
3. The discovery hierarchy matches our Loader
4. The emission patterns accurately describe our Registry dispatch
